# FDGD026

> PERMITTED: Moving Members to a Base Class

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section D.8.1 Moving Members to a Base Class.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application none, test none
- Status: verified

It cannot be safely undone: moving the member back is FDGD028. PublicApiAnalyzers (optional in /fdg-setup) can flag changes to the public API.

## From the book

Moving a member to a base class is gracefully handled by the .NET CLR and is generally supported for both static and instance members in .NET languages.

The .NET BCL team considers this an acceptable change, but would warn you that it cannot be safely undone.
